entities.summary: Anthony Okonkwo Gbuji is a Nigerian Roman Catholic prelate, who served as a bishop of Diocese of Enugu from 1997 to 2009. He was ordained priest on 23 November 1958 at Propaganda Fidei Chapel, Rome by Pietro Cardinal Agaginian the Prefect of the Congregation. Gbuji is a doctor of Canon Law. Anthony Okonkwo Gbuji was a religious figures from Nigeria (b. 1931-10-29). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
